scenes.caption: Support the head, neck and shoulders
scenes.narration_line: Support their head, neck, and shoulders throughout the hold.
safety_points: Support the head and neck at all times.

scenes.caption: Support their bottom; lift gently
scenes.narration_line: Put one hand beneath their head, the other beneath their bottom.

scenes.caption: Cradle the head and whole body
scenes.narration_line: Rest their head in your arm's bend; support their body underneath.
safety_points: Support shoulders, back and bottom with your other arm.

scenes.caption: Hold close; handle gently
scenes.narration_line: Keep them close, move gently, and never shake your baby.
